info.name: SmartERP API
info.description: SmartERP API v2.1 collection. Import the matching local environment. Authenticate with a Super Admin account for the workflow requests; set or create related IDs as documented. Database-unavailable test is manual only.

item.name: Refresh - rotate cookie token
item.description: Postman sends the HttpOnly smarterp_refresh cookie from its cookie jar; do not add a Cookie header.

item.name: Logout - revoke refresh session
item.description: Uses and clears the refresh cookie stored by Postman's cookie jar.

item.name: Request admin password reset
item.description: In development, the single-use reset link is printed in the backend console; email delivery is not configured.

item.name: Create employee
item.description: Requires an existing active departmentId. Create or configure a department before sending.

item.name: Adjust stock - add test inventory
item.description: Creates available stock for later purchase and sales workflow examples.

item.name: Create Draft purchase order
item.description: Requires the supplierId and productId created or configured above.

item.name: Approve purchase order
item.description: A user may not approve their own purchase order unless they are Super Admin.

item.name: Reject a separate pending purchase order
item.description: Optional independent example: set rejectablePurchaseOrderId to a Pending Approval PO not created by this same user.

item.name: Cancel a separate eligible purchase order
item.description: Optional independent example: set cancellablePurchaseOrderId to a Draft or Pending Approval PO.

item.name: Receive approved purchase order
item.description: Run after approving the collection's purchase order. This example fully receives its only line.

item.name: Create Draft sales order
item.description: The backend ignores submitted prices and totals; it uses the product price and computes totals.

item.name: Cancel a separate Draft or Confirmed order
item.description: Optional example: replace salesOrderToCancelId in this URL with a separate Draft or Confirmed order ID. A fulfilled order cannot be cancelled.

item.name: Process return and create credit note
item.description: Run after the sales order is fulfilled. Restocks one unit and records a credit note; it does not issue a refund.

item.name: Negative Tests
Expired bearer token
item.description: Generate expiredToken using backend/scripts/make_expired_token.py; see docs/testing.md.

item.name: Insufficient permissions - employee cannot list users
Duplicate purchase receipt - over-receive
item.description: Run only after the Receipts folder has fully received the same PO; the fresh key prevents an idempotency replay.

item.name: Setup - create order that cannot be stocked
Invalid status transition - cancel fulfilled order

item.description: These requests expect standard JSON error envelopes. Some examples require the earlier success requests or preconfigured IDs. Database-unavailable validation is intentionally a documented manual step, not a runnable request; see docs/testing.md.
